title: SignalX Zero design-system coverage report
description: What a design system COVERS, as opposed to what is wrong with it — emitted as dist/report.json by the zero build and by `sigx zero:validate --report-json` (docs/architecture.md, "The authoring surface"). Components styled against the anatomy manifest, the axes each component wires and which are typed `never` by its register artifact, declared-but-unwired values per axis and modifier, per-part state and flag coverage including deliberate `skipStates`, the axis-agnostic divergence partition and the minimum contrast margin per theme. Machine-readable first: the conformance matrix generates its already-proven-in-repo rows from this file, so they cannot go stale by hand.

$schema.description: Self-reference to this schema — the emitter always writes exactly this URL.

reportVersion.description: Shape version of this document. Bumped when a consumer would have to change to keep reading it. 2 added the required `score` section.

name.description: The design system's name, as declared on the design-system input.

lynx.description: The lynx target's capability findings — present only when the build ran with targets: ['web', 'lynx']. What the lynx emitters translated (semantically equivalent projection) or dropped (not expressible on the target; each entry says how to patch it), so "what did the lynx copy lose" has one answer in the same file that answers "what did this design system ship".

webOnly.description: Ecosystem scopes excluded from the lynx target because a discovered pack's recipe references a web-runtime mechanism the lynx emitter refuses. A first-party recipe in the same position fails the build; a discovered pack's is dropped instead, because the design system's author neither wrote it nor can fix it.

coverage.description: Components styled, against the anatomy manifest validated to.

unstyled.description: Manifest scopes with no recipe — they render unstyled. Sorted.

vocabulary.description: What the design system DECLARES, before any question of what its recipes wire.

declaredOut.description: Axes declared OUT of existence rather than merely left unwired — `roles: {}` retires colour, `sizes: []` retires the size ramp, `variants: []` retires the variant axis. Only an explicitly empty declaration lands here: omitting `tokens.variants` means "declared nothing", not "no variant axis".

scopes.description: Per-scope restrictions of the vocabularies above (docs/architecture.md, "Declared vocabulary") — scope → the part of each axis vocabulary that scope offers. `{}` when the design system declares none, which is what makes the lists above the whole vocabulary rather than a union of per-scope ones. An empty list under a scope is the claim "this scope has no such axis".

unwired.description: Declared, but wired by no recipe anywhere — the attribute renders and matches nothing. The validator warns for variant, custom axes and modifiers; colour and size have no such check, so for those this is the only place the gap is stated.

unclaimed.description: Declared, but in NO scope's vocabulary — the union carries a value that belongs to nobody (docs/architecture.md, "Declared vocabulary"). `unwired` is about what the recipes paint; this is about what the declaration promises. Always empty while any styled scope is unrestricted for that axis: an unrestricted scope's vocabulary IS the union, so nothing can be unclaimed.

components.description: Every scope in the anatomy manifest, styled or not.

divergence.description: The axis-agnostic partition: per axis, the per-component value sets, flagging any component wiring a strict subset of its siblings. Keyed by axis name, plus `mods` — modifier names are a value set like any other.

contrast.description: The static contrast matrix, per theme — present when the report was built beside an audit that computed it (`buildReport(…, { contrast })`). Declared-pair contrast (`themes`) says what the tokens promise; this says what the recipe cascade produces when states combine, with every cell the estimate could not judge counted by reason rather than dropped.

api.description: The vendor-named component API surfaces (issue #179), one row per vendor prop, sorted by prop — present only when the design system declares an `api`. Grades are derived from the declaration the ./components artifact is emitted from, so a conformance-matrix row generated from this section cannot claim a mapping the artifact doesn't implement.

issues.description: Validation counts, present only when the report was built alongside a validation pass. The report is a coverage document and stands without one.

audit.description: The audit's counts (auditDesignSystem, #403) — present when the report was built beside an audit, which the zero build and `sigx zero:validate --report` both do. The findings live in dist/audit.json (audit.schema.json); this is what the score's `audit` criterion reads.

byRule.description: Finding count per rule that fired. The key set mirrors audit.schema.json's ruleId — a test pins both against AUDIT_RULES.

criterion.description: One scored criterion: 0–100 (one decimal), its weight in the total, and the counts it was computed from.

score.description: The composite score (docs/architecture.md, "The authoring surface"): five named criteria — six when an audit score was handed in — weighted into a total and a letter grade. A declined axis (`declaredOut`) and a fill role (`content: false` / `soft: false`) cost nothing; `skipStates` earns half credit; the weakest theme is the one graded. Per-scope `variant` wiring is deliberately not scored.

lynxFindings.description: One list of lynx capability findings — where in the recipe/tokens source, what was found, and what happened to it.

scope.description: The anatomy scope, when the finding is about a recipe.

package.description: The ecosystem package owning `scope`, when a discovered pack does — so a finding about a recipe the design system did not write says whose it is.

apiSurface.description: One surface of the vendor-named component API: the prop consumers write, where it routes on zero, and the conformance fidelity grade (docs/architecture.md, "The authoring surface").

prop.description: The vendor prop name — a valid JSX attribute (dashes allowed, no whitespace).

zero.description: The zero surface the prop routes to: `color`, `size`, `variant`, `axes.<axis>` or `mods.<modifier>`.

respelled.description: Vendor spellings that differ from the zero value they map to, sorted. Non-empty implies grade `reshaped`.

axisValue.description: An axis VALUE: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, repeated hyphens included (Carbon's danger--tertiary) — what a quoted [data-…="…"] attribute selector, a single-quoted literal union in register.d.ts and an unescaped lynx class name (zx-a-<axis>-<value>) all carry verbatim. Wider than the kebab-case grammar names take; still no %, ., quotes, backslashes, whitespace or uppercase.

valueList.description: A duplicate-free list of axis VALUES (the wider grammar). Same ordering rule as tokenList.

valueListsByAxis.description: Custom axis name → its value list.

kebabToken.description: A kebab-case identifier that may start with a digit — the grammar shared by scope, part, state, flag, axis and modifier names (and role names, which are also colour-axis values).

tokenList.description: A duplicate-free list of kebab-case names. Harvested sets are sorted; DECLARED vocabularies (`vocabulary.sizes`, `vocabulary.variants`, `vocabulary.axes`) keep declaration order, because a ramp's order is part of what it says.

tokenListsByAxis.description: Custom axis name → its value list.

component.description: One anatomy scope. A scope with no recipe carries `styled: false` and nothing else — the register artifact emits no entry for it either, so it has no axes to report.

parts.description: Always empty: with no recipe there is nothing to cover, part by part.

axes.description: The three contract axes, always all present.

mods.description: Presence-only modifiers this recipe wires, rendered `data-mod-<name>`.

defaults.description: The recipe's `defaultVariants`, when it has any. Documentation only — a default never widens a generated union.

never.description: The contract axes this design system's register artifact types `never` — exactly the axes whose status is not `wired`. Derived from the same harvest as the artifact, so the two cannot disagree.

parts.description: Every part the anatomy declares for this scope, styled by the recipe or not.

offered.description: The values this scope's own vocabulary offers — present only when `tokens.scopes` restricts this axis for this scope. `wired` is what the recipe delivers against it.

status.description: `undeclared` means the design system has no such axis (`roles: {}` / `sizes: []`) and is reachable only for colour and size; `unwired` means the axis exists and this recipe keys nothing on it. Both produce `never` in the register artifact — they differ in what the author should do about it.

styled.description: Whether the recipe styles this part anywhere — `parts.<name>`, a variant or compound block, or a modifier. A part reached only through a variant is styled, so this agrees with the coverage buckets rather than with the shape of the authoring input.

states.description: Coverage of the part's closed `data-state` vocabulary.

flags.description: Coverage of the part's presence-only flags.

coverageSplit.description: Every declared name of a part, in exactly one bucket.

covered.description: Styled unconditionally on the part — through `states` or a raw `selectors` key that gates on the state.

coveredIndirectly.description: Styled, but only inside an `at` condition, a variant, a compound or a modifier — real coverage that an attribute has to match first.

skipped.description: Listed in the recipe's `skipStates` — deliberately delegated elsewhere rather than forgotten.

wiredAnywhere.description: The union any component wires. Divergence is measured against this rather than against the declared vocabulary, so a value held back everywhere on purpose says nothing while a component lagging behind its siblings does.

byComponent.description: Scope → its value set. Only components wiring at least one value: wiring nothing is `never`, not divergence.

subsets.description: Components wiring a STRICT subset of `wiredAnywhere` — where an axis value renders as the default here but not elsewhere.

declared.description: Of `subsets`, the scopes whose narrower set is exactly what their scope vocabulary declared — a declared narrowing is the design system saying what it means, not divergence.

themeContrast.description: Declared-pair contrast for one theme. Role pairs only — what the recipe cascade produces when states combine is measured by the Playwright state-matrix audit, not here.

pair.description: The opposite-scheme theme this one pairs with, when it declares one.

minContrast.description: The smallest ratio across every declared pair — the margin this theme has left. Null when no pair could be measured, which the validator reports as errors of its own.

worstPair.description: [background, foreground] of the pair `minContrast` came from.

belowMin.description: Pairs below the 3:1 hard floor — each one is a validator error.

belowAA.description: Pairs below 4.5:1 AA text contrast, `belowMin` included — each one is at least a validator warning.

ratio.description: WCAG contrast ratio, rounded to two decimals so a committed report is not a diff against itself.

contrastTheme.description: One theme of the static contrast matrix, summarised. The full cell table lives in the audit result (`AuditResult.contrast`).

cells.description: Every cell the matrix produced for this theme.

measured.description: Cells with a ratio — `cells` minus unmeasured, unrendered and unpainted.

disabledFailing.description: `disabled` cells whose pre-fade pair is below 2:1.

unmeasured.description: Reason → how many cells the estimate could not judge for it.

worst.description: The ten lowest measured ratios, worst first.
